concerns.text: FR-008 requires a Friedman test with post‑hoc Bonferroni comparisons to assess whether transformation type significantly affects error rates. The original idea only asks *how* transformations alter Type I error and power; it does not prescribe a specific omnibus test. Introducing this particular statistical test adds a methodological layer that was not requested and may bias the interpretation.

FR-008 also mandates a sensitivity analysis that sweeps the significance level α across a range of small values. This creates a new research question—how error rates vary with α—that was not part of the original research question. It expands the scope beyond measuring Type I error at the conventional α = 0.05 and power, constituting scope creep.
